summary: Synchronize Wellman runtime package with standard 0.20.46

delivery.outcome: Publish the Wellman runtime package at 0.20.46 so adopters of the immutable standard can install the exact runtime requested by the governance workflow.
nonGoals: Change the already published immutable standard release

architecture.decision: Keep the runtime package version equal to the published standard version and use the existing tag-triggered trusted publisher. Do not retag or mutate the immutable standard release.
architecture.rollback: Revert the unpublished branch; never retag the existing standard release.

commands: python3 -c "import json, tomllib; assert open('VERSION').read().strip() == '0.20.46'; assert tomllib.load(open('packages/wellman/pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['version'] == '0.20.46'; assert json.load(open('governance/manifest.default.json'))['standard']['version'] == '0.20.46'; assert json.load(open('governance/manifest.hub.json'))['standard']['version'] == '0.20.46'"
validation.evidence: Runtime and standard projections agree, the package builds, and governance fixtures pass.
